description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailManTester' within the namespace 'Step\[Acceptance]' that extends acceptance testing capabilities for email configuration in SuiteCRM. It contains methods to navigate to email settings and to populate email configuration fields within tests.

classes.name: EmailManTester
classes.description: Acceptance testing class for email management features, extending functionality to navigate and configure email settings in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: gotoEmailSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the email settings page within SuiteCRM by clicking on user menu items.

methods.name: createEmailSettings
methods.description: Populates the email settings form with test data, including email address, password, and configuration options, preparing for email functionality testing.
